inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Four children's records were reviewed and two are missing a health statement from their physician.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: During inspection it was found that the Parenti's Rights is not included in the parent handbook.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: During inspection three of four caregiver files were missing 16 hours of pre-service training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Employees Discipline Own Children: During the investigation it was determined a caregiver spanked a relative child during operation hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employees Discipline Own Children (26 TAC §746.2807)

occurrences.finding: Doors to Restroom - Employee in Restroom With Children Under 5 Years of Age: During the investigation it was determined a child was able to lock the bathroom door from the inside and an adult was not in the area with the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Doors to Restroom - Employee in Restroom With Children Under 5 Years of Age (26 TAC §746.4421(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: Three children were observed to be in restrictive devices for 30 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary: Infants were observed being fed  snack in their beds instead of in a high chair or table.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary (26 TAC §746.3317)

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: An infant was observed to be sleeping in a restrictive device for 20 minutes before being moved.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Employees Comply with Standards: During the investigation, it was determined that caregivers are not supervised appropriately and are not directed to comply with standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Employees Comply with Standards (26 TAC §746.1003(2))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: During the investigation, video footage was obtained that shows a caregiver roughly grab a child and pull them to sit down to address the child's behaviors.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: During the investigation, video footage was obtained that shows a caregiver sitting in a classroom with children that are climbing, fighting, screaming, and pushing.  The caregiver does not intervene or provide activities to engage the children which led to inappropriate discipline and a child being injured.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: During the investigation it was found that a caregiver grabbed and pinched a child who was running away causing marks on the skin.  The caregiver was dismissed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection: During the investigation it was found that the operation had a gas leak.  The operation called and requested an inspection from local plumber during in spection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: During the investigation it was found that there are many ceiling tiles in the each room that are stained from the roof leaks and some have mold.  There are walls that are water damaged and need repair.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: During the investigation it was found that a parent reported that a caregiver was pinching a child but the operation did not report to licensing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Based on a DFPS investigation, it was determined that caregivers grabbed a child on at least 2 occasions as a form of discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: During the investigation it was determined that the caregiver popped a child on the hand as a form of discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: During inspection it was observed that children did not have outdoor playtime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities (26 TAC §746.2206(1))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: During inspection an infant was observed to be in a bouncer for 40 minutes before being removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets: During inspection, three pack n plays were observed with very loose fitting sheets.  These sheets were removed during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2411(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: During inspection, four infants did not have required feeding instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Handwashing Procedures: During inspection, children did not wash hands after playing outside and there is no soap in the restrooms for handwashing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Handwashing Procedures (26 TAC §746.3419)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: During inspection, the following items were not found in the chidlren's records:    746.605(6) Name, address, phone number of emergency contact for all 4 children  Child #1 needs the special care statement box checked  Child #1, #2, and #4 need the parent handbook (operational policies) boxes checked.    Child #4 needs the healthcare Provider Statement or parent check box completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: During inspection, children under two were able to watch a video on a tablet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: During the inspection an infant was observed to be sleeping in a bouncer seat for more than 8 minutes and was not moved when it was brought to the caregivers attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: During inspection a 2m old infant and a 5m old infant were asleep in their pack n play covered with a blanket.  The 2m old also had 2 empty bottles and 1 full bottle at the foot of the bed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: During inspection three rooms did not have adequate lighting during naptime to see the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: A health inspection was available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants 12 Months and Younger: Information about Safe Sleep is not included in the parent handbook.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants 12 Months and Younger (26 TAC §746.501(a)(9))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: A fire inspection report was not available at inspection
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Exits Required: The playground area is missing a section of fence and also requires a gate installed away from the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Exits Required (26 TAC §746.4307)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Gas Inspection Report: A gas inspection was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Gas Inspection Report (26 TAC §746.801(13))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies Procedures for Parent Review Licensing Reports & How to Access Rules: Update your policies to include the following information:  Licensing Office contact:  903-232-3317  Access minimum standards hhs.texas.gov  Abuse/Neglect reporting website:  www.txabusehotline.org
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies Procedures for Parent Review Licensing Reports & How to Access Rules (26 TAC §746.501(a)(22))

occurrences.finding: Care Requirements for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Individual Attention: Interest Centers were not available with toys, games, books, art, etc activities for any of the 10 classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Care Requirements for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Individual Attention (26 TAC §746.2601)

occurrences.finding: Storage for Individual Belongings: Individual storage was not available for children's personal belongings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage for Individual Belongings (26 TAC §746.4505)

occurrences.finding: Operational Policies - Inform Parents Areas Within 1000 feet of Center is a Gang Free Zone: This information is not available and must be either posted, provided directly to parents or put in the handbook.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Operational Policies - Inform Parents Areas Within 1000 feet of Center is a Gang Free Zone (26 TAC §746.501(b)(2))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The parent handbook needs information related to physical activity to include the following:  Promoting   Benefit  Duration  type  setting
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))
